title: Ep. 0001 — Extreme Ownership (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: The leader owns everything in their world — every outcome, every failure, every gap — with zero excuses and zero blame passed down or sideways. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.

title: Ep. 0002 — No Bad Teams, Only Bad Leaders (through the Disciple of Jesus Christ)
description: A team's performance is a direct reflection of its leader's standards, attitude, and example — a struggling team is a leadership problem before it's a personnel problem. Tonight's lens: Disciple of Jesus Christ.
